system directly:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **File access** — reads and writes inside the directory given by `vaultPath`.

- **Network** — none. The plugin makes no outbound req"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"uests and bundles no
server.
- **Commands / credentials** — none.
- **Lifecycle scripts** — `prepare"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"` (runs `npm run build`). Declared explicitly;
it only ever runs `rolldown` locally. The built `lib/"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"` is committed, so a

browser in the layout's `main` slot under th"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"e same key. Clicking the sidebar
icon calls `ctx.layout.selectPanel("obsidian-memory")`, which opens"},{"id":"p36s4","text":" the panel in
the central column. This works on DSH versions that declare the `sidebar.panellist`
li"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"st slot and the keyed `main` slot (verified on the `0.1.5` / `0.1.6` line)."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"On DSH versions released before those slots existed, the two `ctx.slots.inject`
calls are simply ine"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"rt: the plugin still loads, the 5 `obsidian_memory_*` tools
still work, and the sidebar icon simply "},{"id":"p37s3","text":"does not appear. No crash, no install
failure — only the panel is unavailable on those older builds."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"**The five `obsidian_memory_*` tools are unaffected** on every version above."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"### Build reproducibility (fixed in 0.4.0)"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Before 0.4.0 the committed `lib/` depended on the absolute path of the checkout:
rolldown's `//#regi"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"on` comment embedded the CSS virtual module id, lightningcss
mixed the `filename` into its `[hash]` "},{"id":"p40s3","text":"CSS-module prefix, and its export order
was not stable. `npm run build` now produces byte-identical "},{"id":"p40s4","text":"output from any
directory, so the committed bundle matches a rebuild at the same Commit."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"| Component | Role |"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"| **Host** (`lib/index.js`) | Node side: registers tools, reads/writes vault files |
